title: OceanVeil Streams Magical Girl Raising Project restart Anime
content:
The company also recently began streaming the Persona 4 The Animation anime on September 26.

The Magical Girl Raising Project Restart anime debuted on TV Tokyo on Monday late at night at 2:00 a.m. (effectively Tuesday), and then on AT-X and BS Fuji on Wednesday.

The anime stars:

• Yoshino Nanjō as Pfle

• Reina Kondo as Shadow Gale

• Fairouz Ai as Masked Wonder

• Honoka Inoue as Pechka

• Jenya as Nonako Miyokata

• M.A.O as Rionetta

• Mariya Ise as Clantail

• Maaya Uchida as Magical Daisy

• Hime Sawada as Nokko-chan

• Akari Kitō as @Meow-Meow

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Genopsyko Yumenoshima

• Ami Koshimizu as Akane

• Shiori Mikami as Melville

• Maria Naganawa as Cherna Mouse

• Miyu Tomita as Detec Bell

• Aoi Yūki as Lapis Lazuline

• Megumi Han as Keek

Nao Tōyama returns from the original anime as Snow White.

Hiroyuki Hashimoto returns from the first Magical Girl Raising Project anime as the director. Takao Yoshioka is returning to write the script. Masako Itou ( Magical Girl Raising Project SD character designer) is designing the characters for the new anime based on original designs by Maruino . Satoki Iida is returning as sound director. Synergy SP is the new animation studio, replacing Lerche that animated the previous Magical Girl Raising Project anime. Minori Chihara performs the anime's opening theme song "No tears here." Daisy×Daisy performs the ending theme song "ReMind."

The first 12-episode Magical Girl Raising Project anime premiered in Japan on the AT-X channel in October 2016, and Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired.

Endō's Mahō Shōjo Ikusei Keikaku light novel series is set in a world where a social game called The Magical Girl Raising Project allows one in tens of thousands of people to be a "magical girl" — possessing extraordinary physical capabilities and looks, as well as special magical powers that set them apart from the rest of the human race. But one day, in a district containing 16 magical girls, the administration announces that it must halve the number of magical girls to solve the problem of magical energy. At first, the 16 magical girls race to collect more "magical candy" than their competitors, but the rules quickly become twisted, and it quickly becomes a murderous battle for survival among them.

Endō launched the original light novel series through Takarajimasha 's Kono Light Novel ga Sugoi! Bunko imprint in June 2012, and Takarajimasha published the 18th volume in November 2023. The second and third light novel volumes, published in November and December 2012, cover the "Restart" arc. Yen Press began publishing the novel series in English in June 2017.

Nori-Senbei launched the manga adaptation of the "Restart" arc in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comp Ace magazine in 2016, and Kadokawa published one volume in September 2016.

title: Overgeared Confirms Episode Count After Premiere, But Is It Really the New Solo Leveling?
content:
Overgeared has kicked off its run this Fall as a new Korean webcomic release that fans will want to keep an eye out for, but is it really going to be a fitting replacement for Solo Leveling when its episodes wrap up their runs. The Fall 2026 anime schedule has brought with it a number of cool looking new anime adaptation that fans are now starting to see in action, but there’s one series that has made a big connection with the massively popular Solo Leveling franchise thanks to a special crossover between the two .

Solo Leveling has been carving out a path for new Korean webcomic turned anime releases , and some have already been much bigger hits than the others. Overgeared was setting up to be a major series that fans are looking forward to seeing more of, and now it’s been confirmed to run for 12 episodes according to retailer listings of its Blu-ray and DVD releases in Japan. Now with this new anime already underway, can it actually take the Solo Leveling crown?

Overgeared Confirms Episode Count for Fall 2026

Overgeared has revealed it will be running for 12 episodes spread across two Blu-ray/DVD volumes in Japan, but there’s still a chance that more episodes could be revealed. For now, it seems like the series is only going to run for a single cour of episodes for the Fall before it wraps up its debut season. And it’s getting off to an interesting start because while it had initially drawn many comparison to other hits like Solo Leveling , there’s another show that actually scratches a much closer itch that fans of that franchise will want to seek out.

Overgeared is set in a world where one virtual reality game is so big and popular, that doing well in it results in a great deal of success in the real world. But the actual stakes of each episode aren’t very high as Grid is ultimately just playing a game and leveling up in the only ways he can (which includes using any kind of exploit he can to do so). And for that reason, this show is more like Katarina’s Shangri-La Frontier franchise instead ( which is now in the works on coming back next year with another season ).

What Makes Overgeared Stand Out?

If you liked the way that Shangri-La Frontier plays out, you’ll love Overgeared. That series follows its own main character, Sunraku, as he grinds through the game and uses his own exploits to make it as fun as possible. It gets real particular about how each of the stats, gear and more have an impact on combat. Overgeared seems to be the same way so far as Grid is trying his best to skip the lower levels and essentially cheese his way to fame and fortune in the real world.

Grid’s main attribute is the fact that he seems kind of like a terrible person, and that’s likely going to be very fun to watch over the course of its run this Fall. There might be more planned in the future given how much of the webcomics there needs to be covered, but how are you feeling about Overgeared so far? Does it scratch that Solo Leveling itch? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Boruto Kicks Off Major Anniversary With Teases for the Naruto Sequel’s Future
content:
The Boruto series entered its 10th year earlier this May, but the celebration is still not over, as the series has major plans ahead. This new information comes directly from the series, as it has opened a new website listing the major plans it has for its 10th anniversary. What makes this addition even more exciting is that Two Blue Vortex has also entered its 3rd anniversary, meaning there could be new information on where this second installment of Boruto is headed. But for now, what Boruto actually has planned for its next installment includes two major things.

One of the first things that is very exciting is that the new official website lists a “Special Movie” coming soon. With the trend of many new anime now getting adapted into movies, it is easy to interpret that perhaps the next installment of the series, the anime adaptation of Naruto ‘s next anime, could arrive in movie format . That said, there is a lot of ambiguity, and it could mean anything. Meanwhile, an advertisement for the series has also been announced. Considering the recent release of the 9th Volume of the Boruto: Two Blue Vortex manga , it could mean that this advertisement is related to the volume itself. While there is a lot of ambiguity, fans should not fret, as there is seemingly a date when everything could be unveiled, and it is sooner than you think

Boruto Is Planning Two Major Surprises With More in the Future

The special advertisement for the series is listed for sometime this month, and the exact date might also be revealed. The New York Comic Con event is being held on October 10, where the Naruto franchise is getting a panel, which seems like the perfect place for the series to unveil details and teases about the special movie. The advertisement could also be scheduled for this day itself. The biggest tease from the entire panel is indeed the mention of the special movie. While there are reasons to believe there will be a movie for the series, especially as the anime series has been quiet for a long time, it could mean something entirely different.

The term “Special Movie” has already been used previously in other promotions for the franchise, and they were all about special promotional videos. This means the special movie could actually be about celebrating Boruto ‘s 10th anniversary with a short video, while other small elements at the events could simply be celebrating the series’ milestone. That said, announcements about the future of the series could still be made, and they might instead appear in December of this year at an even bigger event. Shonen Jump’s Jump Festa event takes place every December, where major updates for various Shonen Jump franchises are unveiled.

With a Special Stage allocated to the Naruto franchise , there is a strong possibility that the future of the Boruto anime could be revealed. With rumors that Two Blue Vortex is already in production, this could be the place where fans finally see an update. As Naruto ‘s sequel, Boruto is indeed the future of what the Naruto franchise has created, and its 10th anniversary celebration being extended this long only hints that there is still major exciting news for the series that fans can expect soon, at the very least before the end of this year.

title: Young Magazine USA Special Gets 2nd Issue
content:
Kodansha had teased in November 2025 that it was preparing a second issue of Young Magazine USA .

The first Young Magazine US special issue commemorated the magazine's 45th anniversary. The 1,044-page magazine had 18 new series from Japanese artists, as well as the first chapter of Kengo Hanazawa 's Under Ninja manga, and Shūichi Shigeno 's ( Initial D , MF Ghost ) new manga Subaru and Subaru . The magazine also featured a cover illustration by Ghost in the Shell creator Masamune Shirow .

The magazine's special issue was distributed for free to attendees at Anime NYC in August 2025, and was distributed at specific Kinokuniya locations from August to November 2025.

The titles are available to read on the magazine's official website , which launched in August 2025. Digital reading and distribution platform GlobalComix also released the special issue for free. Azuki ( now Omoi ) also released the issue for free for all users, which was available until last December.

The top five winners of the magazine's reader poll campaign are guaranteed serialization on Kodansha 's K MANGA app. The winners also get serialized in Japan in Monthly Young Magazine and/or YanMaga Web , serializing at the same time on K MANGA .

Winning titles include Still You , Godmother , The Knight of Blasphemy , The Journey of a Dark Elf with Fading Powers , and Fascination . Additional titles getting that have earned seraliziations include To Dusk and Twilight , Boys Run the Riot -In Transition- , Protocol Ryugu , and The Last Terran .

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Series Returns With New Anime Revival After 16 Years – Watch Opening
content:
It’s been 16 years since this manga series had been cancelled within the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, and Psyren has returned for a brand new anime revival this Fall. The new wave of anime releases for the Fall 2026 anime schedule has officially begun, and it means fans are now finally getting to see some of their most anticipated new releases of the year. Some of these adaptations have had fans waiting quite a long time for their respective debuts, and that’s especially the case with this one.

Toshiaki Iwashiro’s Psyren was cancelled within Shonen Jump way back in 2010, and ultimately only had 100 chapters under its belt. But like how fans got to see in action with the recent anime revival for Black Torch this Summer after its own cancellation , Psyren is getting a whole new chance at life with its own anime debut after all this time. And it’s kicking things off with a cool opening and ending theme sequence that you can check out in action below.

Psyren Makes Anime Debut After 16 Years

Psyren is now officially streaming as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule, and the first episode is now available to watch with Crunchyroll (where they are exclusively offering it outside of Japan ). There’s also an English dub release planned for the new anime revival, but no release details have yet to be confirmed as of this time. The opening theme for the anime is titled “WARNING!!” as performed by CLAN QUEEN (which you can find in the video above), and the ending theme for it is titled “Icarus” as performed by Who-ya Extended (which you can find in the video below).

As for the production staff putting it all together, Katsumi Ono is directing the anime revival with animation production handled by Satelight. Shin Yoshida is handling its scripts, Akira Okuma is designing the characters, and Takashi Ohmama, Tatsuhiko Saiki, Shu Kanematsu is composing the music. But it’s yet to be revealed just how long this anime revival is going to be sticking around for. Though it has been touted to be a complete adaptation of that cancelled Shonen Jump story .

What Does This Mean for Shonen Jump’s Anime Future?

Original series creator Toshiaki Iwashiro noted through promotional materials for the anime that he’s working closely with the production team on the new anime series, and it’s likely that it will result in the most complete version of the story yet. It’s the dawn of a new era with Shonen Jump as while this series had been cancelled 16 years ago at this point, the franchise has found a whole new life through this revival. And might just reach a new audience of potential fans in the process.

Black Torch did the same earlier this Summer, and adapted its full story within a single season of the anime. The creator behind it all teased that the franchise could continue with an original story for its second season , and that could end up being the same case for Psyren as well. If the series does find a new success with fans even this long after this cancellation, Shonen Jump just might want to do the same with even more forgotten and cancelled series.

How are you feeling about the Psyren anime revival so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Anime Gets Same-Day English Dub
content:
The English dub stars:

• Justin Briner as Rein

• Hollis Beck as Lily

• Lacey Deline as Nina

• KyLeigh Zimmerer as Elsie

• Rick Robertson as Barrius

The dub staff includes:

• Studio: Crunchyroll

• Studio Producers: Justin Cook, Michael Harcourt, Nathanael Harrison

• Producer: Susie Nixon

• Adaptation Supervisor: Tyler Walker

• Adaptation: Clayton Browning

• Adaptation Prep: Marilyn M. Reyes, Benjamin Tehrani

• Voice Director: Jerry Jewell

• Talent Coordination: Tara A. Williams, Brittni Hurley

• Engineering Managers: Gino Palencia, Brandon Peters

• Engineer: Sawyer Pfledderer

• Mixer: Andrew Tipps

The anime will premiere on TV Tokyo and its affiliates on Tuesday at 24:00 (effectively, Wednesday at midnight), and on AT-X on Thursday. Crunchyroll will stream the anime as it airs in Japan.

Shochiku describes the anime:

Rein, an enchanter who strengthens equipment with his magic, is suddenly expelled from his guild, simply because every piece of gear in the guild has already been enhanced enough. Outraged by the absurd treatment, Rein decides to take back the enormous amount of mana he had poured into their equipment. When he casually channels it into a random copper sword, it transforms into a cheat-level weapon with 10,000 enhancement points! With zero combat experience but armed with magic that can turn anything into overpowered gear, this enchanter sets off to enjoy a new, carefree life as an adventurer! In a world where magic and science intertwine, wild humor meets layered character drama, fueling nonstop fan theories and generating major buzz long before the anime was even announced.

Shū Honma ( Ya Boy Kongming! , Mayonaka Punch , Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 "Sisters") is directing the anime at P.A. Works . Yōko Yonaiyama ( Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk , mono, Ya Boy Kongming! ) is in charge of the series scripts. Tadahito Kiyosawa is designing the characters, with Masami Gohda as the sub-character designer. Both Kiyosawa and Gohda also serve as chief animation directors.

Rokushima began serializing the original story in the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in January 2021, and is still updating the story. Kodansha published the first print volume of the novels with illustrations by kisui in January 2022, and the second volume shipped in October 2022.

Gyōmuyōmochi launched the manga adaptation in Kodansha 's Shōnen Magazine R in November 2021, and moved the manga to Kodansha 's Comic Days app in March 2023 after Shōnen Magazine R ended publication. Kodansha released the manga's 21st compiled book volume on August 7. Kodansha 's K MANGA service is releasing the manga digitally in English.

Kodansha released the manga's 21st compiled book volume on August 7. Kodansha 's K MANGA service is releasing the manga digitally in English.

title: Demon Slayer Studio’s Next Big Movie Shows Off Surprise Crossover
content:
The studio behind Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba has a new movie on the way, and it’s gearing up for its debut with a cool crossover with another of Ufotable’s biggest franchises. Fans might be anxiously waiting to find out new updates on the next film in the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle trilogy, but studio Ufotable has been keeping quite busy with other projects in the meantime. That includes another feature film that’s slated to make its way through theaters in Japan later this Fall.

Witch on the Holy Night is the next major feature film release coming from Studio Ufotable after they had been working on other TYPE-MOON franchise releases in the past such as various anime in the Fate series. Now with the newest film bringing TYPE-MOON back to the big screen with Studio Ufotable , the two franchises have united in a cool crossover to get fans ready for the new movie. Check it out below.

Witch on the Holy Night x Fate/Zero Crossover Revealed

To help celebrate the upcoming debut of Witch on the Holy Night in Japan , TYPE-MOON and Ufotable have kicked off a “Let’s all watch it together! TYPE-MOON × ufotable” special crossover project for both franchises. This will include a special broadcast of certain films from Ufotable’s TYPE-MOON adaptations in the region, but also this special crossover visual with Fate/Zero. With the classic series also celebrating its 15th anniversary in Japan as of this month, it’s a big event for fans in quite a few ways with that classic series getting more love after all this time.

Witch on the Holy Night will be making its debut in Japan on November 20th, so it won’t be too much longer before fans get to see it all in action. Making matters even more enticing is the fact that the film has also confirmed it will be coming to international territories in 2027. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will be bringing the new film to the United States, Canada and more international territories on January 29th next year , but there could be even more updates about it by the end of the year.

What to Know for Witch on the Holy Night

Witch on the Holy Night is directed by Masashi Takeuchi for ufotable with Moe Tsuzuki providing the character designs, Manabu Kamino handling the editing, and Hideyuki Fukasawa composing the music. The Japanese cast will be reprising their respective roles from the original TYPE-MOON visual novel too with the likes of Haruka Tomatsu as Aoko Aozaki, Kana Hanazawa as Alice Kuonji, and Yusuke Kobayashi as Soujyuro Sizuki confirmed thus far. But any potential English dub cast members have yet to be announced as of this time.

The film will be releasing in the United States with both Japanese and Engliah language audio, but we will likely see more updates for it revealed in the coming months. This crossover further emphasizes just how many similarities that the TYPE-MOON franchises have with one another, and Ufotable has been able to elevate that even more for their respective anime outings over the years. But how are you liking the way Witch on the Holy Night looks so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: MediaOCD Announces Deal to Sell Physical Editions of Manga from Manga Mavericks Books, Mahjong Pros
content:
Manga currently available on MediaOCD 's website from Manga Mavericks Books include ALTERNATIVE[SELF LINER NOTE], First Time in Taiwan: A Delicious Adventure, FISHGOD, Great Metal God , Horon of the Closed Country , Princess Da Huang & Other Tales, The Pipe Machine , Vegetable Sandwich , and Zigoku's Foreman .

The Manga Mavericks website and podcast established the Manga Mavericks Books publishing division in April 2025 to license, localize, and distribute works worldwide from indie creators in Japan.

Manga Mavericks announced in July the Independent Manga Alliance, an industry association and joint venture between Manga Mavericks CEO Varun Gupta and Mahjong Pros head of partnerships and licensing Harrison Doan . The venture aims to provide distribution, marketing, and sales support to independent creators and small publishers, linking them to partner publishers and distributors located in the United States or globally. The founding members of the Independent Manga Alliance are Manga Mavericks Books , Mahjong Pros , Strict Algorithm LLC , Red String Manga, and Curation Entertainment Partners Inc.

Manga Mavericks Books entered a distribution deal with Pathway Book Service and with Gazelle Book Services Ltd for Europe last February. Pathway is handling comprehensive book fulfillment, warehousing, and retail distribution for Manga Mavericks Books .

Mahjong set company Mahjong Pros ' Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint focuses on licensing, localizing, and distributing mahjong-themed manga and textbooks. The company announced its Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint in June 2025.

title: Hunter x Hunter Creator Shares New Health Update Amidst Shonen Jump Hiatus
content:
Hunter x Hunter is back on hiatus from the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, and the creator behind it all has shared a new update on changes to their schedule. Yoshihiro Togashi began Hunter x Hunter decades ago , but the series unfortunately has gone on hiatus multiple times through the course of its serialization. Some of these hiatuses have lasted for years at a time as the creator’s poor health unfortunately makes it difficult to maintain a steadier release schedule for the chapters. But Togashi has made great strides in the past few years.

Togashi has been returning to Shonen Jump in the 2020s with more steady chapter releases with only a couple of years of hiatus in between. Returning for ten new chapters earlier this Summer before going on hiatus once more , the creator took to social media to announce even more changes to his production schedule as he notes that he’s no longer taking on any work that requires to be turned in under a deadline at this time.

Hunter x Hunter Creator Shares New Production Update Amid Shonen Jump Hiatus

As Togashi noted to fans on social media, “Due to a combination of physical and mental health issues, I’ve decided that after completing the work I’m currently committed to, I will turn down all future requests that come with deadlines and prioritize working on my own manuscripts,” the creator stated. “Once I’m able to resume work on them, I’ll announce it on Twitter.” It seems that while working on new chapters of Hunter x Hunter, the creator had been working on other tasks and keeping up with deadlines. But it seems like his health has made it to where he can only work on the coming chapters of his own manuscripts instead .

Hunter x Hunter recently went back on hiatus after resuming for ten new chapters earlier this year . This was following a two year hiatus where the creator previously returned to Shonen Jump for a slate of ten chapters as well. This seems to be the pattern for Togashi and Shueisha’s editors at this time. The creator returns every couple of years for a physical volume’s worth of chapters, and it means we’ll eventually get to the end of the Succession Contest Arc in the coming years.

What Does This Mean for Hunter x Hunter?

Hunter x Hunter has gone on hiatus following the release of Chapter 420 of the manga, and Togashi is already hard at work on the next ten chapters of the series. If he continues at the same pace as before, it’s likely going to be a 2028 release window for the chapters. With the Succession Contest Arc now at its climax , it also means that the Dark Continent is closer than ever before. But there are so many characters now in the mix in the latest chapters, it’s hard to gauge where it’s all going.

Hunter x Hunter fans have been anxious to see many of their favorites in action, and that unfortunately has been one of the most stinging aspects of each of these hiatuses. Gon and Killua finally made a cameo appearance in the manga’s pages after nearly 15 long years, and that just made the waiting all the more intense. But how are you feeling about Hunter x Hunter right now? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Confirms U.S. Release Date & New Streaming Platform
content:
Dragon Ball Super is coming our way with a new remake anime series offering an enhanced version of the original TV series, and it has expanded its streaming offerings with a new United States release date update. Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is an new take on the now classic TV anime series that’s going all the way back to the Battle of Gods arc, and it’s going to be one of the big releases fans can’t wait to check out this October . Now it’s gotten a whole new streaming platform ahead of its release.

Crunchyroll has officially announced that they will be streaming Dragon Ball Super: Beerus alongside its release in Japan on October 11th. This is following the reveal that Netflix would also be offering the series some time after on October 17th. This makes its release with Crunchyroll the first one that fans should look into if they want to check out the remake as soon as the new episodes hit. It’s time to mark your calendars for the big debut.

Dragon Ball Super Remake Confirms Crunchyroll Streaming Release Date

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be making its debut on October 11th in Japan , and will be streaming its new episodes with Crunchyroll for fans in the United States, Canada, Latin America including Brazil, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, India, Southeast Asia and Europe. It will then be followed by a streaming release with Netflix a week later on October 17th. Both streaming services will be offering the remake with Japanese language audio and English subtitles, but any potential English dub release plans have yet to be announced as of this time.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be an “enhanced” edition of the original TV anime series teased by Toei to feature “extensive new cuts, revisions to existing scenes, a complete re-rendering of all footage, newly recorded dubbing with added score and sound effects, and a full reconstruction of the story. ” The extent of the changes have yet to be revealed as of this time, but will be far more clear once the anime starts to kick off its remake run in full later this month.

What to Know for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be directed by Tadayoshi Yamamuro for Toei Animation with Matsuto Seya providing the composition and direction arrangement, Eichi Nishimura serving as editor, Yosuke Motoki serving as compositing director, and Norihito Sumitomo composing the music. The new remake series is also getting an update set of opening and ending themes for the occasion too. The new opening theme is titled “ONOGAMI” as performed by MEGATERA・ZERO, and a new ending theme titled “Kan Peki No Peki” as performed by VK Blanka.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be adapting the Battle of Gods, Resurrection F, and Universe 6 arcs from the original TV anime series, but it’s yet to be revealed whether or not fans will see the other arcs get their own remakes as of this time. It’s also yet to be confirmed how many episodes this new series will have on offer either , so there’s lots to look forward to either way. Are you excited to check out Dragon Ball Super ‘s remake this Fall? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
